# @sharadox/interface-web-library

> Accessible, themable React 19 interface pieces with no words of their own (every label is a property) and no global stylesheet (CSS modules read --interface-* custom properties).

- /interface-theme: InterfaceTheme({ theme: Partial<{ background, surface, surfaceRaised, text, textSoft, line, accent, accentText, danger, success, radius, smallRadius, font, fontDisplay, barHeight, shadow, fieldBackground, fieldBorder, fieldHeight, fieldFocus, labelSize, labelSpacing, labelCase, buttonRadius, buttonHeight, buttonPadding, buttonGap, buttonSize, buttonWeight, buttonSpacing, buttonCase, primaryBackground, primaryBackgroundSize, primaryText, primaryShadow, primaryShadowHover, primaryGlint, secondaryEdge, secondaryEdgeHover, secondaryTextHover, plainUnderline, cardRadius, cardPadding, cardBackground, cardEdge, cardLight, cardEdgeLight }>, className? }); interfaceThemeStyle(theme) → { "--interface-…": value }
- /button: Button({ look?: "primary" (filled) | "secondary" (outlined) | "plain" (text) | "danger", pending?, pendingLabel?, icon? (icon-web-library IconName), arrow? (trailing chevron sliding on hover), ...button attributes }) or with href: a link that looks the same ({ href, link?: ComponentType (default next/link Link; e.g. a section-gliding link), target?, rel?, arrow defaults true })
- /card: Card({ title?, description?, tone?: "danger", action?, children }) — client component; action centered beside the content; surface and 1px edge from the theme, lit by the pointer (useSpotlight sets --pointer-x/y)
- /checkbox: Checkbox({ label, ...input }) — native checkbox drawn like buttons (outlined / filled)
- /code-boxes: CodeBoxes({ label, digitLabel, ofLabel, name?, length? (6), onComplete?(code), invalid?, disabled?, describedBy?, autoFocus? }); square boxes over the width; paste fills every box; Backspace/Delete clear the current box
- /copy-button: CopyButton({ value, label, copiedLabel, onCopied? })
- /dialog: Dialog({ open, onClose, title, closeLabel, children }) — native modal <dialog>, centered, Escape/backdrop/close button; leaves with the opening animation reversed
- /pending-mark: PendingMark({ label }) — role=status spinner beside an optimistic value
- /skeleton: Skeleton({ label, shape?: "lines" | "card" | "list" | "profile" | "cards", lines?, rows?, height? })
- /select: Select({ label, options: { value, label }[], value?, defaultValue?, onChange?(value), name?, placeholder?, disabled?, id?, className? }) — custom listbox, native keyboard behavior, hidden input with name
- /skeleton-value: SkeletonValue({ label?, width? ("8ch"), circle? }) — inline skeleton for one value
- /switch: Switch({ label, checked, onChange(checked) → Promise<boolean | unknown> }) — optimistic: flips at once, aria-busy loader, flips back when onChange answers false
- /text-field: TextField({ label, tip?: { text, label }, prefix?, suffix?, hint?, error?, ...input }) — prefix/suffix are separate sections
- /tip: Tip({ text, label })
- /toast: ToastProvider({ label, dismissLabel, duration? }), useToast().notify(message, tone?: "success" | "info" | "error")
- SCSS: @use "style/interface" as *; tokens ($background, $surface, $raised, $text, $soft, $line, $accent, $accent-text, $danger, $success, $radius, $small-radius, $font, $display, $bar, $shadow, $field-*, $label-*), mixins scrollbar, focus, card, visually-hidden
